note: Alberta Parks campground on Lake Newell, 13 km south of Brooks off Hwy 873; loops either side of the park road, with Kinbrook Marsh and its interpretive trail beside the southern loops. Boat launch and a seasonal food concession. Site numbers and loop names changed for the 2025/26 season (Alberta Parks advisory, Oct 2025): check the shop map before booking. The shower building is closed for the 2026 season while a new one is built (advisory from Jan 8, 2026). Water, showers and the dump station are off from early October to May, when winter rates apply and some loops close. --Claude
